research_packets.title: Decision-time integrity and usable source history
research_packets.question: Which exact source revisions and owner clocks can support each proposed historical or prospective claim?
research_packets.population: A source-readiness census of supported identities, dates, source families and coverage strata; not an outcome-selected ticker list.
research_packets.inputs: Data OS identities, immutable source generations, observation/publication clocks, adjustment basis, episode generations, current model-vintage records.
research_packets.controls: Late capture, same-date correction, current-only event discovery, missing sessions, renamed/reorganized security and unknown model vintage.
research_packets.method: Trace representative source-to-decision paths with explicit cutoff joins. Measure coverage without looking at protected strategy outcomes; map irrecoverable history to prospective-only use.
research_packets.decision: An approved evidence matrix specifying observed-as-run, PIT replay or diagnostic eligibility for each input/date; missing compulsory inputs block only affected claims.
research_packets.falsifier: Any declared PIT path depends on a current body, later membership, future label or unproven clock. Repair or exclude it before fitting.
research_packets.current_authority: Existing protocol/owner and current source law; this registry grants no admission/outcome access/dispatch.

research_packets.title: Winner/loser and missed-opportunity attribution
research_packets.question: Which part of the pipeline most often destroys useful opportunity or introduces avoidable downside?
research_packets.population: A complete dated supported cohort with original decisions and all dispositions; individual winners/losers illustrate rather than define it.
research_packets.inputs: Nominations, suppressions, B1 relations, original board rank/visibility, availability, accepted publication, entry/management and outcome references.
research_packets.controls: Cohort/era separation; control-only V3 tape; no ticker-ever conversion substitute; unresolved joins remain counted.
research_packets.method: Build a layered failure decomposition before recommending a rule. Separate discovery, ranking, delivery, entry, management and common exposure. Quantify attribution uncertainty.
research_packets.decision: Select the next largest identifiable capability loss and its corresponding research/build edge; do not tune V3 from a pooled headline.
research_packets.falsifier: The diagnosis reverses under original-time joins or depends on hindsight-selected names. Return a measurement correction rather than a trading rule.
research_packets.current_authority: Existing protocol/owner and current source law; this registry grants no admission/outcome access/dispatch.

research_packets.title: High-recall expert union and independent origination
research_packets.question: Do additional registered nomination species reveal useful opportunities earlier at the same review burden?
research_packets.population: Frozen supported universe and source-defined observation times, including nominees that never originate B1 or never confirm.
research_packets.inputs: Exact TURN WATCH/TOI/Radar/Doors versions, source-native anchors, false/unknown trigger distinctions, history and liquidity coverage.
research_packets.controls: Incumbent nomination set; duplicate-expert ablation; equal review burden; rejected-species equivalence review.
research_packets.method: Compare new incremental episodes and pre-B1 sightings, time-to-first-useful-entry, coverage and adverse cases. Use B1-approved anchor/re-arm only.
research_packets.decision: Promote an observation or strategy species only for its separately supported claim; broaden the visible field without silently widening trade admission.
research_packets.falsifier: Incremental rows are late duplicates, illiquid cases or unproductive noise, or value exists only after future confirmation filtering.
research_packets.current_authority: Existing protocol/owner and current source law; this registry grants no admission/outcome access/dispatch.

research_packets.title: Same-origin daily/multi-day/intraday entry timing
research_packets.question: When does earlier lawful observation improve the complete entry policy rather than just the surviving filled trades?
research_packets.population: Same original eligible episodes across early-lawful, slower-confirmation, pullback and cash policies; no eventual-confirmation selection.
research_packets.inputs: Registered bar anchoring, source/decision validity, first observable episode, quote/basis and geometry, declared fixed management.
research_packets.controls: Same episodes and exits; never-confirmers/no-pullback cases; latency and cost sensitivity; incumbent next-close convention disclosed.
research_packets.method: Date-weighted paired full-opportunity H10 proposal with H5/H15 supporting for this new study. Separate episode-clock and fill-clock results and dependence.
research_packets.decision: Identify a bounded species/timeframe policy worth qualification, with exact availability requirements; do not grant confluence waiver via adapter.
research_packets.falsifier: Apparent early-entry gain disappears when failures, no-entry, gaps or real latency are retained, or depends on provisional bars treated as final.
research_packets.current_authority: Existing protocol/owner and current source law; this registry grants no admission/outcome access/dispatch.

research_packets.title: Group leadership, member selection and self-confirmation
research_packets.question: Does group information improve selection beyond the candidate itself and ordinary industry exposure?
research_packets.population: Candidate-date observations with supported point-in-time group membership/weights; current-only cohorts separately labeled.
research_packets.inputs: GMI leadership, breadth, concentration, peer-excluding-candidate returns, own-stock residual/relative behavior and source lineage.
research_packets.controls: Own-stock-only; industry-only; leave-one-out peer; common-date weights; singleton and overlapping-theme controls.
research_packets.method: Compare group allocation and within-group selection contributions on matched endpoints, then test incremental forecast/research utility.
research_packets.decision: Retain only measurable independent group information and its uncertainty; an attractive group visualization is not promotion evidence.
research_packets.falsifier: The candidate generates the apparent confirmation, or current membership/popularity/sector beta explains the entire lift.
research_packets.current_authority: Existing protocol/owner and current source law; this registry grants no admission/outcome access/dispatch.

research_packets.title: Comparable earnings and expectations
research_packets.question: Which economic changes carry remaining opportunity after the information becomes usable and price responds?
research_packets.population: Predeclared ordinary-accounting operating-company event cohort; separate post-release, issuer-guidance and licensed-analyst constructions.
research_packets.inputs: Event revisions, comparable facts/periods/bases, guidance, EPS/share changes, contributor estimates where licensed, release/call/filing times.
research_packets.controls: Own-price; issuer change only; matched surprise; contributor composition and forecast rollover; same-coverage enriched versus base models.
research_packets.method: Separate operating mechanisms, expectations, price response and policy capture. Propose H42 primary, H21/H63 supporting; freeze definitions before outcomes.
research_packets.decision: Approve specific fact/expectation features and a supported event species, not a universal earnings-quality bonus.
research_packets.falsifier: Lift is driven by restatement, GAAP/adjusted mismatch, changed contributors, horizon roll, already-earned gaps or a handful of selected events.
research_packets.current_authority: Existing protocol/owner and current source law; this registry grants no admission/outcome access/dispatch.

research_packets.title: Cycle proving-domain and economic-turn identification
research_packets.question: Which domain offers an interpretable, historically measurable economic recovery mechanism without choosing recent winners?
research_packets.population: Source-readiness candidate industrial capital goods/machinery; final universe selected by coverage/mapping criteria before return inspection.
research_packets.inputs: Vintage orders, backlog, shipments, inventories, production, issuer segments and failure histories; common definition changes documented.
research_packets.controls: Domain breadth and composition; inventory-versus-sales interpretation; latest-revised versus vintage evidence; sector distress is not recovery.
research_packets.method: Qualify economic-series and issuer mapping, then define observable filtered turn hypotheses and negative controls; no future-smoothed phase labels.
research_packets.decision: One admissible pilot domain with explicit coverage and falsifiers, or a documented alternative chosen by the same readiness rule.
research_packets.falsifier: Apparent turn exists only in revised series, coarse proxies, survivorship-selected names, or future-known cycle troughs.
research_packets.current_authority: Existing protocol/owner and current source law; this registry grants no admission/outcome access/dispatch.

research_packets.title: Funding, dilution and original-equity recovery
research_packets.question: Can the issuer survive until recovery, and does the original shareholder capture value after financing?
research_packets.population: All eligible cycle issuers including dilution, debt stress, failed firms, canceled shares and reorganizations.
research_packets.inputs: Dated cash and obligations, restricted cash/facilities, debt maturity, maintenance needs, hedging and diluted-share/claim structure.
research_packets.controls: Simple cash/burn; enterprise-value recovery only; survival-only; full original-security terminal outcomes.
research_packets.method: Build explicit joint scenarios with financing proceeds already reflected in net debt; test incremental economic prediction and realized equity capture separately.
research_packets.decision: A source-backed solvency/per-share view and qualified features; scenario ranges remain assumptions until calibrated.
research_packets.falsifier: Recovery value vanishes for original shares, or outcomes improve only after failed firms and canceled securities are excluded.
research_packets.current_authority: Existing protocol/owner and current source law; this registry grants no admission/outcome access/dispatch.

research_packets.title: Multi-head remaining opportunity and payoff timing
research_packets.question: Can separate payoff, adverse-tail and time-to-event forecasts improve decisions beyond stage labels?
research_packets.population: Strategy-specific origin and registered current-landmark cohorts; no mixing of horizons or repeated rows as independent observations.
research_packets.inputs: Source-qualified base/economic features, accepted geometry, costs, fixed-horizon and first-event labels with explicit censoring/missing states.
research_packets.controls: Stage/horizon base rates; regularized return/logistic models; simple discrete competing-risk model before high-capacity alternatives.
research_packets.method: Evaluate net/relative means, quantiles, severe-loss and coherent target/invalidation timing; calibrate each head on held-out dates and top-K cohorts.
research_packets.decision: Accept heads individually only where supported and useful; abstain on unsupported heads rather than force all fields into UI.
research_packets.falsifier: No incremental policy value, incoherent first-event probabilities, poor selected-cohort calibration or hindsight path ordering.
research_packets.current_authority: Existing protocol/owner and current source law; this registry grants no admission/outcome access/dispatch.

research_packets.title: Ranking objectives and economic tradeoffs
research_packets.question: Which ordering best serves a declared review/entry task without compressing all strategies into one score?
research_packets.population: Exact same candidate-date-strategy-horizon populations; actionable and research purposes separately identified.
research_packets.inputs: Qualified features/heads, current availability references, workload limit and declared risk preferences.
research_packets.controls: Incumbent V3 control; strong linear/additive rank; grouped boosted ranking; same information and cost assumptions.
research_packets.method: Freeze query grain, relevance label, objective and primary top-of-list metric. Compare net value/coverage/tails and rank stability; separately calibrate probabilities.
research_packets.decision: An accepted ranking artifact and supported purpose; ranking margin remains a relevance score, not a probability.
research_packets.falsifier: Win comes from altered population, arbitrary post-outcome penalties, extra information, or turnover that erases gains.
research_packets.current_authority: Existing protocol/owner and current source law; this registry grants no admission/outcome access/dispatch.

research_packets.title: Calibration, abstention and user-visible confidence
research_packets.question: Which forecasts remain reliable after top-K selection and across evidence coverage?
research_packets.population: Held-out strategy/horizon/coverage cohorts and meaningful adverse events, retaining unavailable outputs.
research_packets.inputs: Frozen predictions, calibrator vintages, proper labels, risk/coverage and selected-population information.
research_packets.controls: Uncalibrated model; simple calibration; base-rate/shrinkage; coverage-matched comparisons.
research_packets.method: Assess proper scoring rules, reliability, interval width/coverage, tail sample counts and selective risk/coverage. Avoid automatic conditional guarantees.
research_packets.decision: Expose only qualified heads and meaningful uncertainty; unsupported precision stays absent.
research_packets.falsifier: Pooled calibration hides top-K failures, abstention drops hard cases without coverage reporting, or rare-event N is inadequate.
research_packets.current_authority: Existing protocol/owner and current source law; this registry grants no admission/outcome access/dispatch.

research_packets.title: Context routing and behavioral fingerprints
research_packets.question: Do specific mechanism-by-context interactions add value beyond a global model?

research_packets.inputs: Dated macro/group context, stable source-backed behavioral features, prior allowed routing evidence.
research_packets.controls: Global model; partial pooling; broad priors; name/permutation controls and identical source coverage.
research_packets.method: Register one interaction hypothesis at a time under the existing conditioning protocol; shrink thin cells and inspect out-of-support behavior.
research_packets.decision: A bounded conditional feature/expert rule if it earns incremental evidence; no broad universal regime authority.
research_packets.falsifier: Performance depends on tiny cells, indirect ticker memorization, recent-expert chasing, or unestimable interactions.
research_packets.current_authority: Existing protocol/owner and current source law; this registry grants no admission/outcome access/dispatch.

research_packets.title: Execution realism, bars and latency
